svg.title: Peblo AI Hub: chat with citations, model picker and sources drawer
svg.desc: Mid-fidelity wireframe of the AI Hub page. Left: icon rail and conversation list. Centre: a chat grounded in the user's notes with numbered citations, the model picker open (local and cloud models with badges), and attach-context chips in the composer. Right: the Sources used drawer showing exactly which notes, tasks and events the model saw.
